title: A sprint's start or precheck names a committed item whose touches are item files only, with the drop route, before any claim
goal: precheck SP and start SP name each committed story, task or bug whose scope is item files only (bl_check.item_files_only) and the route that closes it (a planning commit, then drop --why), so the orchestrator does not learn it from a done refusal at landing

run:

sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
